decisions.decision: Ms. Doherty will contact Steve Malandrinos, Director of the town's Information Technology Department, about board members' inability to access their town email accounts.
decisions.quote: ms. doherty said she'd contact steve malandrinos director of the town's information technology department.

decisions.decision: Board members will come to the next meeting to compile their answers to the cable advisory committee's request for feedback on town department cable use.
decisions.quote: board members said they'd come to the next meeting to compile their answers.

decisions.decision: A small holiday party and ornament swap at the December 8 meeting, which most members favored; members who want to bring ornaments are welcome to do so.
decisions.quote: ms. lincoln suggested a small holiday party and ornament swap, most were in favor.

budget_items.topic: Meals on Wheels worker pay and fund shifts
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director reported Meals on Wheels workers are now paid every two months and that she had shifted funds around for drivers, with no dollar figure given.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty also reported that she's had to shift funds around to account for drivers going to florida

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director reported 9 participants in last year's work-off program and that the committee is working on the 2016 program; no dollar figure given.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty reported that the committee is working on the 2016 program

budget_items.topic: Eagle House washer/dryer and roof repair
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Director said the Eagle House should invest in an apartment-sized washer/dryer for linens used at lunch, and noted roof repair is in the capital plan; no dollar figures given.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty also expressed that the eagle house should invest in an apartment sized washer/dryer to clean towels, aprons, and table cloths used during lunch.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: RUOK program may return through a grant from the Community Health Care Fund, with a grant deadline of Nov. 20; no dollar amount given.
budget_items.quote: the ruok program hopefully will be coming back to lunenburg through a grant by the community health care fund.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Cheryl Aubuchon said the Eagle House Supporters would donate another $1,000 for the Eagle Scout's project.
budget_items.quote: cheryl aubuchon from the eagle house supporters said they'd donate another $1,000 for the eagle scout's project.

budget_items.topic: Council on Aging board training lunch cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board training on Nov. 16 at the Eagle House includes soup and sandwich day at a stated price.
budget_items.quote: registration is at 8:45 a.m. and it's soup and sandwich day which is $3.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Items added to the Eagle House capital plan are a new roof, parking lot, and possibly a washer/dryer; no dollar figures given.
budget_items.quote: ms. doherty reported that items added to the eagle house capital plan are: new roof, parking lot, and possibly a washer/dryer.
